messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy-start] env=prod-usw tag=release-2024-04-17 commit=3a7f2d4
    Deploy kicked off by pipeline. Rolling out model-swap + config v2.1 to runtime pools.

alex: saw a small spike in p95 right after the first batch landed, watching.

maria_oncall: @alex oncall ready if you want me to hold the window.

deploy-bot: [progress] pool=runtime-gpu-a batch=1/12 status=ok

ci-bot: quick note: smoke tests failed 1/12 on tokenization mismatch, rerun queued.

eva: tokenization mismatch across 2 locales, this could be model artifact. 

alex: bumping to high priority, let's pause further batches. Can we stop rollout and pin previous tag?

jon: +1 pause. run rollback for cluster runtime-gpu-a first, then pin to release-2024-04-10.

deploy-bot: [action] initiating automated backout due to latency and mismatch signals. reason="tokenization-mismatch && p95-latency>750ms"

maria_oncall: adding incident channel #incidents-runtime for visibility :rotating_light:

alex: commands I ran locally: ```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/runtime-service --to-revision=20240410
redwoodctl pin model release-2024-04-10 --env prod-usw --reason "autorevert: tokenization/latency"
```

deploy-bot: [rollback-started] env=prod-usw target_tag=release-2024-04-10 initiated_by=deploy-bot commit=3a7f2d4

ci-bot: smoke re-run queued against pinned tag.

eva: monitoring KV cache warmup and prefix cache hits, will report back on error rates.

deploy-bot: [rollback-progress] pool=runtime-gpu-a batch=cleanup status=in-progress

alex: leaving a note in release notes: reverted model swap. Will open an eval ticket to compare tokenization diffs.

maria_oncall: coordinating with infra to check autoscaler logs around 14:03 UTC.

deploy-bot: [rollback-complete] env=prod-usw reverted_to=release-2024-04-10 pin=release-2024-04-10 duration=00:06:42 status=success

jon: confirmed p95 back to normal range, no new tokenization errors in the smoke suite. Great work.

alex: follow-ups: 1) run A/B evals against the model swap in staging, 2) add a toggle to the rollout to skip tokenization-modifying layers, 3) schedule a canary window next week.

maria_oncall: documented the rollback in the change log and escalated to product for model contract review. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [announce] rollback done and previous tag pinned. Notification sent to #releases and #incidents-runtime.

jon: thanks team. closing thread, will reopen if regressions reappear.
